description: This is a Java unit test source file for the DiagnosisServiceImpl class in the OpenMRS project. It contains JUnit test cases verifying the behavior of diagnosis-related methods, including saving diagnoses, retrieving by UUID or ID, garbage collection, attribute management, void/unvoid functionality, and attribute type management.

classes.name: DiagnosisServiceImplTest
